Module ru.ashemchuk.task_2_3_1
Package ru.ashemchuk.model.game

Record Class GameState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ru.ashemchuk.model.game.GameState
Record Components:
playerSnakePositions - positions of the player snake's body segments
robotSnakePositions - list of positions for each robot snake
foods - list of food items currently on the field
score - current player score
gameOver - true if the game is over
win - true if the player has won the current level
currentLevel - the level currently being played
public record GameState(List<Point> playerSnakePositions, List<List<Point>> robotSnakePositions, List<Food> foods, int score, boolean gameOver, boolean win, Level currentLevel) extends Record
Immutable record representing the state of the game at a given moment. Contains positions of the player snake, robot snakes, food items, score, game-over status, win status, and the current level.
